Aarav practised ordering BCE and CE dates; BCE ordering was partly right but not steady yet. Their BCE mix-up was corrected later: they placed 3000 BCE before 500 BCE and 100 CE.
Aarav practised judging what a source shows, leaves out, and why sources are cross-checked; this was partly right but not steady yet.

end.parentNote: Asha practised BCE/CE timelines and checking historical sources with Aarav. Aarav corrected the BCE ordering mix-up later, but source types and the idea that one written account gives the whole truth still need more practice. At home, compare one written account with an object or picture and ask what each source shows and leaves out.

Doosre saboot dekhkar jeet ka daava jaanchte hain. Aap soch rahe hain ki raja ne likhwaya hai, toh sach hi hoga. Par sochiye, cricket mein ek team apni jeet ki baat bataye aur doosri team ka haal na bataye; kya poore match ki kahaani mil jaayegi?
nahi na, poori kahaani nahi milegi. doosri team ka haal nahi pata hoga. par yeh toh cricket hai, history mein toh sirf jo likha hai wahi sach hota hai. kya screen pe kuch draw hua? dikhao na!

Haan, doosri team ka haal chhoot jaayega. Main ab ek saadha chitra banane ki koshish karti hoon, asli photo nahi. Agar raja likhwaye ki sabke paas bharpoor khaana tha, par khudai mein kuch gharon ke khaali bhandaar milen, toh uske daave ko kaise jaanchenge?

khaali bhandaar ka matlab kuch nahi tha khaane ko, toh raja ka daawa galat hai? lekin likha toh raja ne hi hai na, ho sakta hai kuch ghar chhod diye gaye hon. aapne jo board pe likha 'Doosra paksh: ?' wo kya hai?

Doosra paksh ka matlab un logon ki baat hai jinke baare mein raja ne nahi likhwaya. Aapka ghar chhodne wala andaaza bhi mumkin hai; khaali bhandaar se akela raja ka daawa galat saabit nahi hota. Ab shilalekh aur matke se milne wale saboot alag karke dekhein: har ek kya bata sakta hai jo doosra nahi?
shilalekh mein toh raja ne khud likhwaya hoga ki wo jeeta, wo sahi hai. matka bas bartan hai, usme kuch likha nahi, toh wo kuch nahi bata sakta. photo dikhao na, matka dikhao!

Main uski tasveer banwane ko keh rahi hoon; abhi shabdon mein sochiye: matke ke andar jale hue anaaj ke daane milein, toh bina likhe bhi khaane ke baare mein pata chalega. Aap keh rahe hain ki likha hua hi sach batata hai, par raja ka shilalekh un daanon ke baare mein chup ho sakta hai. Un daanon se humein kya pata chal sakta hai?
